name: Ukyo Nanami
source:
"There aren’t many things I’m wrapped up in, right now. So, if you ever need, feel free to wrap me up in something."

Reigns from the Heavens with a dirty vocabulary. 

[From [url=https://twitter.com/sinxholic/status/1649746670928769026]Twitter[/url]]
